Darkness, gloom, and 120 Lightroots: all the Depths' mechanics explained at once — read this before going into the Depths.

地底是王国之泪新增的一整层地图：漆黑、广阔、到处是瘴气，但也藏着电池、矿石和强力 Boss。这篇把地底生存的全部机制一次讲清：瘴气怎么算、怎么照明、120 棵树根怎么点、下地底前带什么。

The Depths are a whole new layer of map added in Tears of the Kingdom: pitch black, vast, and full of gloom everywhere, but also hiding batteries, ore, and powerful bosses. This article explains all the Depths survival mechanics at once: how gloom is calculated, how to light your way, how to activate the 120 Lightroots, and what to bring before going into the Depths.
⭐ 本篇要点
⭐ Key Points of This Article
瘴气侵蚀的是红心上限，普通料理修不了，要用光明根光环或向阳草料理。
Gloom erodes your maximum hearts; ordinary meals can't repair it — use a Lightroot's aura or Sundelion meals.
照明三件套：光亮花种子（射远处）、巨大光亮花种子（当车灯）、发光料理（照自身）。
The three-piece lighting kit: Brightbloom Seeds (shoot them far away), Giant Brightbloom Seeds (as vehicle headlights), and Bright meals (to light yourself).
120 棵破魔之根与地面 120 座神庙一一镜像，点亮就是传送点。
The 120 Lightroots mirror the 120 surface shrines one by one; lighting one makes it a travel point.
地形与地表相反：地表是山的地方，地底是低地；地表是河的地方，地底是高墙。
The terrain is the opposite of the surface: where the surface has mountains, the Depths have lowlands; where the surface has rivers, the Depths have high walls.

常见问题
FAQ
地底到处是红色的瘴气池，带瘴气的敌人打中你也会附带瘴气伤害。瘴气伤害的特殊之处在于：它侵蚀的是红心上限。被侵蚀的心会变成无法使用的状态，这时候吃普通恢复料理，只能填补剩下可用的心，修不了被侵蚀的那部分。很多人觉得“吃了药怎么还是残血”，原因就在这里。

The Depths are full of red gloom pools everywhere, and gloom-infused enemies also deal gloom damage when they hit you. What's special about gloom damage is that it erodes your maximum hearts. Eroded hearts become unusable, and at that point eating ordinary recovery meals can only fill the hearts still usable — it can't repair the eroded part. Many people wonder “why am I still at low health after eating medicine?” — this is why.
站进光明根光环：走到任意已激活的破魔之根下方，光环会逐步修复被侵蚀的心。地底探索时养成“路过树根就站一会儿”的习惯。

Stand in a Lightroot's aura: walk beneath any activated Lightroot, and its aura will gradually repair your eroded hearts. While exploring the Depths, build the habit of “standing a while whenever you pass a Lightroot.”

Stand in a Lightroot's aura: walk beneath any activated Lightroot, and its aura will gradually repair your eroded hearts.
地底探索时养成“路过树根就站一会儿”的习惯。
While exploring the Depths, build the habit of “standing a while whenever you pass a Lightroot.”
回地面阳光下：从深穴回到地表，阳光会自动恢复被侵蚀的心。适合侵蚀严重、又离树根很远的时候。

Return to sunlight on the surface: go back to the surface from a chasm, and sunlight will automatically restore your eroded hearts. This suits times when the erosion is severe and you're far from a Lightroot.

向阳草料理：用向阳草（天空岛上采）做料理，会带“回复瘴气伤害”效果。1 个向阳草修 3 颗，3 个修 9 颗，5 个修 15 颗；向阳草 × 3 加顶级兽肉 × 2，还能一边修 9 颗一边回普通血量。注意：修完上限后心还是空的，要再吃普通料理补血。

Sundelion meals: cooking with Sundelions (gathered on the Sky Islands) gives a “restore gloom damage” effect. 1 Sundelion repairs 3 hearts, 3 repair 9, and 5 repair 15; 3 Sundelions plus 2 Prime Meats can also repair 9 hearts while restoring ordinary health at the same time. Note: after the cap is repaired, the hearts are still empty — eat ordinary meals to refill health.

另外提醒一句：闇之块做出来的是“暂时瘴气防护”，作用是减少受到的瘴气伤害，和向阳草“修复已受的侵蚀”用途不同，别搞混了。

One more reminder: what Dark Clumps make is “temporary gloom protection,” which reduces the gloom damage you take — a different use from Sundelions' “repairing erosion already suffered,” so don't mix them up.

三件套分工明确：远处用箭射种子，赶路用车灯，身边用发光料理。发光料理只照自身，不能代替破魔之根——第一次进地底，仍要带大量光亮花种子，优先点亮沿途树根。

The three-piece kit has a clear division of labor: shoot seeds with arrows for far away, use the headlight for travelling, and use Bright meals for what's beside you. Bright meals only light yourself and can't replace Lightroots — on your first trip into the Depths, still bring a large number of Brightbloom Seeds, and prioritize lighting the Lightroots along the way.
152座神庙全收集自查指南
Self-Check Guide to Collecting All 152 Shrines
地底一共有 120 棵破魔之根，和地面 120 座神庙一一对应，名字是神庙名的倒序。
The Depths have 120 Lightroots in total, corresponding one by one to 120 surface shrines, with names that are the shrine names reversed.
点亮一棵树根有三个好处：照亮周围一大片、解锁该处传送、修复被瘴气侵蚀的心。
Lighting a Lightroot has three benefits: lighting up a large surrounding area, unlocking travel to that spot, and repairing hearts eroded by gloom.
所以地底探索的核心节奏就是：沿着树根一棵一棵点过去，地图自然就亮了。
So the core rhythm of Depths exploration is: light the Lightroots one by one along the way, and the map will naturally light up.
反过来，这个机制也能帮你找漏掉的神庙：有树根、没神庙的地方，就是漏掉的地面神庙，详见本站152座神庙全收集自查指南。

Conversely, this mechanism can also help you find shrines you've missed: a place with a Lightroot but no shrine is a missed surface shrine — see this site's Self-Check Guide to Collecting All 152 Shrines for details.
地底地形和地表大致相反：地表是山脉的地方，地底对应低地；地表是河流湖泊的地方，地底对应无法直接跨越的高墙。出发前先看地表地图推测地底路线，能少走很多冤枉路。入口在地表的深穴，跳下去时记得开滑翔伞控制落点，别直接掉进瘴气池。

Depths terrain is roughly the opposite of the surface: where the surface has mountain ranges, the Depths have lowlands; where the surface has rivers and lakes, the Depths have high walls that can't be crossed directly. Before setting out, look at the surface map first to predict the Depths route, which saves a lot of wasted walking. Entrances are the chasms on the surface; when jumping down, remember to open the Paraglider to control your landing point — don't drop straight into a gloom pool.

Depths Battery and Great Fairy Guide
废矿与制炼所：中央废矿、格鲁德废矿、拉聂尔废矿等地都有制炼魔像，可以用采集的左纳尼乌姆矿石兑换大结晶。

Abandoned mines and forges: the Central Abandoned Mine, Gerudo Abandoned Mine, Lanayru Abandoned Mine, and others all have Forge Constructs, where Zonaite ore you've mined can be exchanged for Large Crystallized Charges.
采矿攒结晶扩电池的完整换算，见本站地底电池与大妖精指南。
For the complete conversion for mining and saving Charges to expand batteries, see this site's Depths Battery and Great Fairy Guide.
地底 Boss：地下人马（白银莱尼尔）、巨霸迦玛、岩石巨人，讨伐后掉落特大结晶（20 个）或特大能量块，是结晶的重要来源。
Depths bosses: underground Lynels (Silver Lynels), Froxes, and Stone Taluses drop a Large Crystallized Charge (worth 20) or Large Zonaite after being defeated, and are an important source of Charges.
光亮花种子：越多越好，探路全靠它。
Brightbloom Seeds: the more the better — scouting relies entirely on them.
向阳草料理：至少做几份修 9 颗的，应付 Boss 战和深区。
Sundelion meals: make at least a few that repair 9 hearts, to handle boss fights and deep areas.
滑翔伞：跳深穴、跨高墙、躲瘴气池都靠它。
Paraglider: jumping into chasms, crossing high walls, and dodging gloom pools all rely on it.
一辆可靠的载具：粘上巨大光亮花种子当车灯，地底赶路效率翻倍。
A reliable vehicle: stick a Giant Brightbloom Seed on it as a headlight, and Depths travelling efficiency doubles.
充足的武器和弓箭：地底敌人普遍比地表硬，别只带一两把。
Plenty of weapons and bows: Depths enemies are generally tougher than surface ones, so don't bring just one or two.
地底有呀哈哈吗？没有。呀哈哈只出现在天空和地面两层。
Are there Koroks in the Depths? No. Koroks only appear in the sky and surface layers.
